## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Love & Care Preschool?
No. 33, 5th Street, LIC Nagar, S. Kolathur, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091 (Monday–Saturday, 9 am–8 pm).

### What facilities does Love & Care Preschool have?
Play Group (1.5–2.5 yrs), Pre-KG (2.5–3.5 yrs), Lower KG (3.5–4.5 yrs), Upper KG (4.5–5.5 yrs), Day care (8 months–12 yrs), Tuition LKG–7th, all syllabuses, Hindi, Abacus, Handwriting, Drawing, Karate, Keyboard, guitar & drums, Phonics, Parent communication app, Daily take-home materials.

### What ages do you take?
Play group from 1.5 years through Upper KG (4.5–5.5 years). Day care takes children from 8 months to 12 years.

### What are the day care timings?
Day care runs from 9 am to 8 pm.

### Do you have after-school classes?
Yes: tuition for LKG to 7th standard (all syllabuses), Hindi, abacus, handwriting, drawing, karate and keyboard, guitar and drums.

### How do I visit Love & Care Preschool?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 86674 48755.
